title: Stage 01 — inspect recovery before changing work
platform: Development browser · desktop and mobile · isolated test profile
summary: Backups now show the records and originals a future restore would affect. The review detects source identity conflicts and changes since an earlier review. Actual browser checks confirmed zero localStorage changes and zero IndexedDB readwrite transactions during review. Full editor restoration remains open.

requirements.change: Verified package inspection, existing-original collisions, corrupt records and stale review detection; 14 focused tests plus actual saved-package browser flow.
requirements.remaining: Replacement itself is not enabled; final acceptance needs the protected restore operation.

requirements.change: Read-only assessment identifies recovery hazards before integration.
requirements.remaining: Durable restore journal, writer exclusion, interrupted recovery and clean-profile restoration.
